info.title: Boat API
info.description: Persistent Ubuntu VMs for AI agents. Auth: Authorization: Bearer boat_<id>_<secret>. Each operation lists its required scope in x-boat-scope. Webhooks are signed: X-Boat-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + body)); during a rotation overlap there is one v1= per secret, accept any match.

get.summary: Caller identity, team, role and effective scopes
Team usage from boatd: VM-seconds by size, snapshot-days
Server-sent VM lifecycle events for the caller's team. Resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after=

post.summary: Create a VM; team secrets and AI proxy tokens go into its env, and an environment's setup runs in it; count > 1 creates a batch, all or none

patch.summary: Rename a VM, set its auto-stop TTL, or push its auto-stop out (boat extend)
patch.description: ttl_s sets the auto-stop length and, on a running VM, the deadline to now + ttl_s (0 = no auto-stop). extend_s moves the deadline of a running VM extend_s seconds past max(deadline, now). Starting a prompt also gives the VM a fresh full TTL. 501 not_supported when boatd predates PATCH /v1/vms/{id}.

post.summary: Resume a stopped VM; secrets re-injected, new AI proxy token

fail_fast.description: answer 503 no_ready_machine at once when the host is full (or boatd is still converting its images) instead of waiting

post.summary: Stop (snapshot) a VM, or with force kill it without one

force.description: kill at once: no guest sync, no snapshot; the next start is a cold boot and loses the page cache, as on a power cut

post.summary: Fork a VM; the child gets its own AI token and copies of the conversations

post.summary: Change size (VM stopped; discard_memory if it has a stop snapshot, then the next start is a cold boot) and/or grow the disk

Start a detached command. It outlives this request

get.summary: Agent harnesses and the models the operator listed for each (-provider-models); boat.dev documents this path for prompt model and reasoningEffort choices

Size.description: A size name from the server's boatd config (default: small, default, large, xlarge); omitted = the server's defaultSize

secrets.description: team secret names (absent = all, [] = none). A disk from a share or import gets none unless named here, which needs the exec scope. Forks inherit it

environment.description: name; default: the team's default environment

from.description: a share code bsh_…; imported first

fail_fast.description: answer 503 no_ready_machine at once when the host is full (or boatd is still converting its images) instead of waiting

count.description: 1-16: create that many VMs, all or none; a name x becomes x-1 … x-N. More than 1 answers {"vms":[…]}

process_id.description: boat.dev's integer id of this command on its VM (processId under /api/v1)

offset.description: may be later than asked if old output rotated away

url.description: only in the create response, with -public-url

token.description: only in the create and rotate responses

expires.description: after this the key answers 401; absent = never

secret.description: only in the create and rotate responses
